mapper.select: SELECT a.*, q.title AS question_title, q.sort_order FROM survey_answer a LEFT JOIN survey_question q ON a.question_id = q.id WHERE a.survey_id = #{surveyId} ORDER BY q.sort_order ASC, a.create_time ASC

SELECT a.question_id, a.answer_content, COUNT(*) AS answer_count FROM survey_answer a INNER JOIN survey_response r ON a.response_id = r.id WHERE a.survey_id = #{surveyId} AND r.status = 1 AND a.question_type IN ('single', 'multi') GROUP BY a.question_id, a.answer_content ORDER BY a.question_id ASC, answer_count DESC
